sentence: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.

source.author: Alan Kay
source.work: Remark associated with Xerox PARC / personal computing talks
source.detail: 常溯至约 1971 年 Alan Kay 在个人计算愿景相关场合的表述；他本人亦多次确认过这一说法。

translation: 预测未来的最好方法，就是去创造它。
grammar: 主干是 The best way ... is to invent it：主语 the best way，系动词 is，表语是不定式 to invent it。
to predict the future 是后置定语，修饰 way，表示「用来……的方式」；英语里 the best / a good way to do sth 是极常用结构。
两个 to do 分工不同：to predict 修饰名词 way，to invent 作表语，说明「是什么」。

vocab.collocation: predict the future; predict an outcome; hard to predict
vocab.example: It is hard to predict how long the bring-up will take.

vocab.meaning: 发明；创造（句中指主动把未来做出来）
vocab.collocation: invent a solution; invent the future; newly invented
vocab.example: We did not wait for a library; we invented a small driver of our own.

vocab.collocation: the best way to learn; the best way to fix; the only way to
vocab.example: The best way to learn a datasheet is to try the registers on real silicon.

vocab.collocation: in the future; the near future; shape the future
vocab.example: Open tools shape the future of embedded workflows.

note: 做工程也一样：与其猜下一步会怎样，不如动手把原型做出来。今天试着口头说一句：The best way to ______ is to ______.
